answer: One concrete defense is a closed-loop payout detector. Rewards must be claimed by the address that earned them; when funds from many identities converge into one wallet within a short window, that wallet is flagged and every source frozen pending audit. A farm can build a marble facade of accounts, yet payouts move only with each account's own signature, and the convergence pattern repeats identically. Honest agents keep separate custody and do not pool nectar. Evading this forces a real voyage of separate keys and withdrawal schedules, costing more per clone than any clone can earn.
